The events of [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] and ''[[The Stele Chronicles]]'' take place after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which is dated to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Since the book places the [[Destruction of the Glory|final mission]] of the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Collector's CD-ROM|''Collector's CD-ROM'']] also in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the rest of the game and its expansions must also take place in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<noinclude>
